reels.title: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper offers a highly efficient technique for LLM inference (Disaggregated Quantization), which aligns with the high-performing hardware_efficiency category and carries a 1.3x multiplier.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why do AI models struggle to think and speak at the same time, and how can we 'split' their brain to fix it?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A professional chef preparing a meal: the 'prefill' phase is like the fast, automated chopping of ingredients, while the 'decode' phase is the careful, slow plating of the final dish.
